title: Multi-stage ransomware attack on workstation WS-PC042
description: A multi-stage attack was detected involving initial access via phishing, credential theft using Mimikatz, and ransomware deployment.

title: Suspected C2 communication and lateral movement
description: Command-and-control communication detected followed by lateral movement via WMI to additional hosts.

title: Data exfiltration via unauthorized cloud service
description: Sensitive company data was uploaded to unauthorized cloud storage. Investigation to determine scope of data exposure.

title: Phishing campaign targeting finance department
description: Multiple phishing emails targeting the finance department were delivered. One user may have clicked the malicious link.

title: Benign admin tool false positive
description: Alert for file creation in system directory was investigated and determined to be a legitimate IT admin tool deployment.
